## Required agent context

Before planning or editing, read `AGENTS.md` and `docs/project/*`, including
`README.md`, `PROJECT_STATE.md`, `ARCHITECTURE_INVARIANTS.md`,
`CURRENT_HANDOFF.md`, `DOMAIN_BOUNDARIES.md`, and the relevant section of
`ROADMAP.md`. Inspect relevant implementation, tests, and Git state. If
repository evidence materially conflicts with those documents, stop and report
the contradiction.
